checkedAlternates.risk: AEDs are used during CPR alongside rescue breathing.
checkedAlternates.resolution: An AED delivers an electrical shock to restore cardiac rhythm (group-1), distinct from airway/ventilation maneuvers (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Tourniquets are applied to life-threatening Red-tag casualties.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A tourniquet is a physical hemorrhage-control device (group-3), not a mass-casualty triage priority tag (group-4).
